questions.stem: What happens during a heart attack (myocardial infarction)?

options.text: A coronary artery becomes blocked, cutting off blood supply to heart muscle
The sinoatrial node stops generating electrical signals
A valve in the heart stops working properly
The heart beats too fast and cannot pump effectively

questions.explanation: A heart attack occurs when a coronary artery becomes blocked, usually by a blood clot forming over a ruptured plaque. This cuts off the oxygen supply to part of the heart muscle, causing those cells to die.
